A slim gold bar filled with ice-blue glass enamel and crossed by fine gold lines that branch the way frost grows on a window. A winter gift for Christmas with nothing seasonal to put away in January.

THE PIECE
6.5 by 17 mm with rounded corners, 1.4 mm thick. Three gold lines run out from a small round node to the frame, with short side lines branching at 60 degrees, so the blue is split into three fields. A 0.7 mm gold border frames the bar. The bail sits at the top back.

4.00 g of 14k gold, counting the chain, clasp and extender. On the scale the finished piece weighs 4.08 g in total with the enamel.

Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque ice blue, level with the gold lines.

LENGTH AND FIT
A 1.0 mm 14k cable chain, 16 in with a 2 in extender, so it sits from 16 to 18 in. The chain is part of the design and its weight is counted in the gold weight above.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece, in a zinc-free gold alloy chosen for enamel. The enamel cells are cast into the gold, filled by hand and kiln-fired. Nothing is soldered after the first firing; any fitting added later is laser welded away from the enamel.

CARE

GIFTING

A riding stirrup in 14k gold with a row of jade-green glass enamel along its tread. It slides on the chain with no bail. An equestrian gift for Christmas that belongs to every season.

THE PIECE
13 mm wide and 16 mm tall. A 1.6 mm rail forms the arched stirrup over a flat 12 mm base bar; five small enamel cells sit in a row on the bar, divided by fine gold ribs. A slot in the top bar takes the chain.

GOLD WEIGHT
3.89 g of 14k gold, counting the chain, clasp and extender. On the scale the finished piece weighs 3.90 g in total with the enamel.

ENAMEL
Kiln-fired vitreous enamel (glass), opaque deep jade green, set just below the gold edges.

LENGTH AND FIT
A 1.2 mm 14k cable chain, 16 in with a 2 in extender, so it sits from 16 to 18 in. The chain is part of the design and its weight is counted in the gold weight above.

HOW IT IS MADE
Made to order. Cast in 14k gold in one piece, in a zinc-free gold alloy chosen for enamel. The enamel cells are cast into the gold, filled by hand and kiln-fired. Nothing is soldered after the first firing; any fitting added later is laser welded away from the enamel.

CARE
Wipe with a soft dry cloth, or wash in warm water with a drop of mild soap. Glass enamel is hard and does not fade, but it can chip if struck against stone or metal. Keep it away from ultrasonic cleaners. No bleach or chlorine.

GIFTING
Arrives in a gift box, ready to give.

products.cold_enamel_paragraph:
ENAMEL
The colour is hand-applied cold enamel (coloured epoxy resin), not kiln-fired glass. It is set into cells cast into the gold, level with the surface. Resin can scratch with wear: avoid ultrasonic and steam cleaning, solvents and perfume on the coloured areas.

workshop.dimensions: Siluet 11 x 15 x 1.35 (doluluk 0.58 -> 95.7 mm2). 3 hucre: gogus/govde 22 mm2, kanat 15 mm2, kuyruk 11 mm2; derinlik 0.55, en dar yer 1.2, duvar ve cevre 0.7, taban 0.80. Yuz maskesi/gaga/tepe kenari ciplak altin; goz D0.8 delik (1.35/0.8 = 1.69). Tepe ucu r0.5. Kulp 1.0 x 1.6 sirt arkasi.
workshop.construction: Tek parca 14K cinkosuz alasim dokum, hucreler dokumde; lehim yok, tas yok. Arka ciplak altin (taban 0.80). Bogurtlen tek renk; tum pisirimler bant alt ucunda (760 C).
bench_sequence: 1. CAD: bitmis + 0.2; hucre koseleri r0.2; goz D0.8 delik; tepe ucu r0.5.
2. Recine baski, besleme sirt arkasindan.
3. Yatirim, yakma, CINKOSUZ 14K vakum dokum; gozenek kontrolu.
4. Tesviye, maske/gaga on cila, goz deligi 0.8 pin-gauge.
5. Depletion gilding 3-4 dongu (593 C + %10 H2SO4).
6. Opak derin bogurtlen (kadmiyumsuz secilmeli) islak dolum.
7. Pisirim 1: 760 C, 90 sn.
8. Pisirim 2: 760 C, 75 sn.
9. Tasla duzleme.
10. Pisirim 3: 760 C, 60 sn parlatma. Asit yok.
11. Tas yok, lazer yok; cila yalniz altin; QC: renk kuponla karsilastir (kahverengiye kayma yok), tartim (uc 1.53 g +/- %5).
bom: Alasim: 14K sari CINKOSUZ mine-uyumlu alasim (Otto Frei 846-180 'No Zinc' master alloy + 24K ile 14K; dokumhaneden yazili Zn=0 sertifikasi ve solidus/DSC degeri), vakum/inert gaz dokum. Bitmis uc 1.532 g x 1.15 = 1.76 g dokum metali.
Mine tozu: kursunsuz, kadmiyumsuz opak derin bogurtlen ~165 mg (pisirilmis 66 mg x ~2.5).
Tas: yok.
Zincir: 14K solid cable 1.0 mm 18in = 1.902 g.
Bulgular: istakoz 0.25 g (tahmin), 2 atlama halkasi 0.060 g, etiket 0.046 g.
